inputs.text: Progressives are seizing on the troubles in Nigeria to renew their relentless attacks on established institutions and national authority, peddling the lie that democracy serves only the rich while criticizing parties like the APC for their preparations ahead of the 2027 elections. These efforts dismiss personal responsibility and pin every problem on traditional power structures, all to demand changes that elevate labor rights and special protections for select groups. Such thinking follows naturally from progressive ideas that erode family values, social order, and cultural continuity in pursuit of global schemes that weaken national sovereignty. Nigeria and countries like it would do far better with stronger authority grounded in tradition instead of these divisive pressures that fracture communities and foster dependency.
